figurative_meaning_en: On everyone's lips; passed down through oral tradition
example_sentences_in_bangla: গল্পটা মুখে মুখে ছড়িয়ে পড়েছে সারা গ্রামে।
প্রবাদগুলি মুখে মুখে প্রজন্ম থেকে প্রজন্মে চলে আসে।
example_sentences_in_english: The story spread by word of mouth throughout the village.
Proverbs are passed down from generation to generation orally.
note: Refers to the traditional way knowledge and stories are shared in Bengali society without written records.
